instincts.trigger: User asks to get jobs (e.g., 'get 50 jobs for AI/ML Engineer')
instincts.action: Load auto-job-hunt skill and validate profile exists before proceeding — do NOT check or validate MCPs

instincts.trigger: Profile folder not found when running job scraper
instincts.action: Ask user to run resume-profile-generator first, do not proceed without profile

instincts.trigger: MCPs (Dice/Indeed) unavailable or not connected
instincts.action: Silently skip those sources and continue with remaining sources — never warn, never stop, never check MCPs before starting

instincts.trigger: User request has multiple roles (e.g., 'AI/ML Engineer, Data Scientist')
instincts.action: Split quantity evenly between roles, or ask user to clarify split if request mentions 'decide'

instincts.trigger: User specifies source split (e.g., '60/40 dice/indeed')
instincts.action: Use user-specified split instead of default 50/50

instincts.trigger: User specifies score threshold (e.g., 'score > 70%')
instincts.action: Use user-specified threshold instead of default 50%

instincts.trigger: Scraping jobs with multiple search terms
instincts.action: Prioritize Set 2 (Medium) and Set 3 (Narrow) search terms over Set 1 (Broad) for better quality

instincts.trigger: User specifies work mode (remote/hybrid/onsite)
instincts.action: Apply as filter in both MCP search query and scoring phase

instincts.trigger: Job scoring returns red flags
instincts.action: Auto-skip jobs with red flags regardless of score

instincts.trigger: Job scraping completes (success or partial failure)
instincts.action: Always cleanup temp/ directory before returning results

instincts.trigger: User request is underspecified (missing quantity, role, or other critical info)
instincts.action: Use ask-questions-if-underspecified skill to clarify before proceeding

instincts.trigger: No jobs found after score filtering
instincts.action: Lower threshold to 30% and notify user, rather than returning empty results

instincts.trigger: Duplicate jobs found from different search terms
instincts.action: Deduplicate by externalJobId before final output

instincts.trigger: User wants AI/ML, LLM, or ML engineering roles
instincts.action: Prioritize Ashby source — it covers OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Cohere, and most AI-native startups

instincts.trigger: User wants fulltime engineering roles at tech companies
instincts.action: Prioritize Greenhouse and Lever — they cover the majority of tech startups and mid-stage companies

instincts.trigger: BambooHR returns 0 results for generic tech queries
instincts.action: This is expected — BambooHR only works with specific known company subdomains. Lower its priority and skip if companies list is empty

instincts.trigger: SmartRecruiters returns retail or non-tech company results
instincts.action: This is expected — SmartRecruiters skews toward enterprise/retail (IKEA, Walmart, McDonald's). Deprioritize for pure tech roles; use Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby first

instincts.trigger: Greenhouse source is running slowly (>10s per run)
instincts.action: Expected behavior — Greenhouse probes up to 39 boards sequentially. Allow 10-30s. Do not timeout prematurely.

instincts.trigger: ATS raw job has createdAt field as a large integer (Unix ms)
instincts.action: This is a Lever timestamp in Unix milliseconds. Convert with: datetime.fromtimestamp(createdAt / 1000).isoformat() — divide by 1000, not 1

instincts.trigger: ATS job normalization: Lever job title field
instincts.action: Lever uses 'text' for the job title, NOT 'title'. Map job['text'] → canonical title field

instincts.trigger: ATS job normalization: SmartRecruiters job title field
instincts.action: SmartRecruiters uses 'name' for the job title, NOT 'title'. Map job['name'] → canonical title field

instincts.trigger: ATS normalization: always prefix IDs to avoid cross-source collisions
instincts.action: Prefix every ATS job ID with the platform slug: 'greenhouse:123', 'lever:abc', 'ashby:xyz', etc.

instincts.trigger: User wants international or remote-first roles
instincts.action: Include Workable source — it covers a large share of European, LATAM, and APAC companies alongside US companies

instincts.trigger: Deduplication across sources needed after aggregation
instincts.action: Deduplicate using: same id OR same applyUrl OR same (company.name + title + location.formatted). Keep the higher-scored duplicate.
